description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named PeerActivity, responsible for displaying a peer count and launching additional instances of itself to simulate peer navigation within an app.

classes.name: PeerActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a peer count and provides functionality to launch additional peer activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, retrieves the peer count from the intent, and updates the TextView with the current peer count.

methods.name: onLaunchPeer
methods.description: Handles the button click event to launch a new instance of PeerActivity, passing along the updated peer count.
